L1:
theorem L1 (n : Nat) : ps_f1 n = n * n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    simp only [ps_f1]
    rw [ih]
    show ps_f1 n + (2 * n + 1) = (n + 1) * (n + 1)
    rw [Nat.add_mul, Nat.mul_add, Nat.mul_one, Nat.one_mul]
    omega
L2:
theorem L2 (n : Nat) : ps_g n = 3 * n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => simp only [ps_g]; rw [ih]; omega
L3:
theorem L3 (n : Nat) : 2 * ps_t n = n * (n + 1) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => simp only [ps_t, Nat.mul_add, Nat.add_mul, Nat.mul_comm]; omega
L4:
theorem L4 (n : Nat) : ps_d (n + 1) = ps_t n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    show ps_d (n + 1) + (n + 1) = ps_t n + (n + 1)
    rw [ih]
